events.label: Наука
entries: 1852 – Annibale de Gasparis discovers the asteroid Massalia from the north dome of the Astronomical Observatory of Capodimonte.
1991 – Ötzi the Iceman is discovered in the Alps on the border between Italy and Austria.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1863 – American Civil War: The first day of the Battle of Chickamauga, in northwestern Georgia, the bloodiest two-day battle of the conflict, and the only significant Confederate victory in the war's Western Theater.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1946 – The Council of Europe is founded following a speech by Winston Churchill at the University of Zurich.
1982 – Scott Fahlman posts the first documented emoticons :-) and :-( on the Carnegie Mellon University bulletin board system.
